name: shinchantw_cbt_guard_beach_event_debug_20260806_100023_227776
sql:
/* 守护海滩事件与关卡字段核对，仅用于修正玩法进度口径。 */
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
)
SELECT
    e."#event_name" AS event_name,
    e."$part_event" AS part_event,
    TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_times,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") AS event_users,
    MIN(TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS min_stage_id,
    MAX(TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS max_stage_id,
    MIN(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) AS min_rst_stage_id,
    MAX(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) AS max_rst_stage_id
FROM ta.v_event_18 e
LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-08-04'
  AND b.user_id IS NULL
  AND (
      TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1006
      OR LOWER(e."#event_name") LIKE '%beach%'
      OR LOWER(e."#event_name") LIKE '%guard%'
  )
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY event_times DESC;
